_comment: Settings of one deployment. Copy to configs/site.json (untracked) and keep the keys you need;
without the file, the deployment is the model server that ./setup connects and no cluster.
served_config: run configuration of the web page before the chosen models.
default_group: GPU group the page selects first.
host_address, python: per-user servers' printed ssh command and interpreter.
persistent: the always-on model server. name is its GPU group and AIProver version; config,
proxy_port: its harness config and reasoning proxy; upstream, model, sessions: what per-user
servers' proxies forward to and the sessions it serves to all users; timeout, session_slots:
per-run session limits; hardware: key in `hardware`.
cluster: a Slurm cluster reached over an SSH ControlMaster. submit is called with checkpoint,
partition, nodes and wall time, with HANDOFF and SBATCH_JOB_NAME exported, and prints

'Submitted batch job N'; the job writes 'node= port=

job=' to HANDOFF.
groups: GPU groups whose server jobs run on the cluster.
hardware: GPUs and hourly price of each server, from a date, for the reported GPU cost.
